name: Sopra i tetti di Venezia
summary: Marco is a baker pigeon and Gina, a dove, is the lady-of-company of the duke's sister, a fat chicken named Ardélia. The duke is responsible for protecting a jewel known as Kuhang which Count Igor wishes to steal. With the help of his friend Gina, Marco will try to keep Kuhang safe from Count Igor.

name: Läckbergs
summary: Camilla Läckberg faces major challenges, including an upcoming 50th birthday, soon-to-be-grown children, and the pressure to deliver a new crime novel. Now we get to take a look at her eventful family life.

name: Fancy Land
summary: Two bizarre murders rock a quiet coastal town, shattering the peaceful life of single mother Li Xiulan and her daughter Li Yan when the police come knocking...

name: Love Story in the 1970s
summary: Set in the 1970s, Fei Ni, an ambitious textile factory worker, dreams of changing her fate through education. Her middle school classmate, Fang Muyang, becomes a local hero after being injured while saving someone. Hoping to gain merit and be recommended for university, Fei Ni volunteers to care for him,but her hopes are repeatedly dashed. As life pressures mount, she proposes a fake marriage to Fang Muyang to secure housing for her brother's wedding. After many challenges, the two finally get a place and become a couple sharing a bunk bed. Through hardship and perseverance, their bond deepens into genuine affection. Eventually, Fei Ni is admitted to university, and Fang Muyang fulfills his dream of becoming a painter. Together, they step into a life filled with warmth, love, and hope for the future.

name: Madam
summary: During the Republican era, a wealthy heiress loses her entire family in a massacre. Twenty years later, she returns as the First Madam of Mo City. On her path of revenge, she forms a blood pact with a proud dragon prince and a cunning jiao dragon. The two become her protectors and silently fall in love with her. Later, a dashing detective joins the race for her heart. With three men vying for her affection, she reopens the investigation into her family's tragedy. Thus begins a legendary Republican tale of love and vengeance.

name: Recruit A General to lead the Troops
summary: Li Chengyu, a food delivery rider, unexpectedly travels back to ancient times and becomes a mighty God of War general. In order to uncover the truth about a rebel case, Li Chengyu disguises himself as a farmer and goes undercover into Qingfeng Stronghold, where he becomes the live-in husband of the stronghold's leader, Chen Xinrou. Using his modern "advanced thinking", Li Chengyu begins his path of reversal. Yet he develops an emotional bond with Chen Xinrou before he knows it...

name: Santas garnachas
summary: A flavorful exploration of Mexico's street food scene, where the beloved garnacha takes center stage, sparks debates and unites fans with every bite.

name: The Motherhood
summary: Each of the six one-hour episodes of The Motherhood follows Britton, a single mother herself, as she connects with another single mother who is juggling the demands of work, parenting, and self-care.  Over the course of a transformative week, Britton and three expert coaches (AKA The Neighbor Ladies)—DIY and home design specialist Angela Rose, positive parenting coach Destini Davis, and style expert Taryn Hicks—help the mom create a harmonious living space, implement effective parenting strategies and refresh her wardrobe.  At the heart of the series is the lasting impact of these changes, as the women build a supportive community to continue uplifting each other long after the cameras stop rolling.

name: Papa datte, Shitai
summary:
Asumi Kouya is a college student who wants to earn some extra money. Utilizing his talents for cooking and cleaning, he accepts a part-time job as a housekeeper. His employer is single father Keiichi Naruse, an attractive young man with a troubling history regarding his former staff.

Naruse's time is constantly dominated by work and his adorable son Ichika, and he rarely gets time to himself. Cleaning the man's room, Asumi gets a startling insight into just how frustrating the life of a single parent can be. He finds a pile of adult videos, which results in plenty of implications.

Despite Naruse being a man, Asumi finds himself completely drawn in by his employer's beautiful face and gentle personality. With the promise of allowing the frustrated father sexual relief, Asumi's life as part of this small family has only just begun.

name: That's Incredible!
summary:
That's Incredible! is an American reality television show that aired on the ABC television network from 1980 to 1984. In the tradition of You Asked for It, Ripley's Believe It or Not! and Real People, the show featured people performing stunts and reenactments of allegedly paranormal events. The show also often featured people with unusual talents, such as speed-talker John Moschitta Jr., who made his first national television appearance on the show, as well as scientific, medical, and technological breakthroughs such as the Taser and cryogenic corneal reshaping by lathe keratomileusis. The show's catchphrase said by one of its hosts at the conclusion of a particularly amazing segment was the same as its title: "That's incredible!"

Despite accusations of being "sadistic", the series was a huge success and influenced many entertainers.

name: Incredible Sunday
summary: That's Incredible! was revived for the 1988–89 season, hosted by Davidson, Cristina Ferrare and Tracey Gold, as Incredible Sunday.

name: Those Amazing Animals
summary: Those Amazing Animals is a reality television series about animals and their extraordinary lives. It was hosted by Burgess Meredith, Jim Stafford and Priscilla Presley. Also appearing were explorer Jacques-Yves Cousteau, undersea photographers Ron and Valerie Taylor, and Joan Embery of the San Diego Zoo. The series aired on ABC on Sunday nights from August 24, 1980, to August 23, 1981. The show was a spin-off of the popular ABC TV Series That's Incredible!

name: Los Telechobis
summary: Ton, Toso, Nita and Tis are 4 elves who discover and learn next to a tree that teaches them many wonderful things while giving advice to the children

name: Слідча
summary: Major Anastasia Yasynska, a principled, determined, and unwavering leader, takes charge of an investigative team where she must work alongside Captain Kyrylo Starley. He is her complete opposite—charming, witty, and used to following his intuition. Together, they tackle the most intricate cases, but the more they work side by side, the stronger the tension between them grows, gradually turning into something more. Their methods differ, their personalities clash, and their emotions become increasingly complicated. Every case presents a new challenge, and every investigation brings them one step closer to their fate.

name: The Flower that Arrived in Winter
Пожить как люди
summary:
Stepan Grachev, a young and ambitious manager, brings documents to the house of the owner of the company, the millionaire Heraklei Lvovich Korneev. At this time, the boss hotly dismisses his deputy and all the servants. Flying to Turkey for two days on business, he instructs Stepan to "look after the house." Stepan enjoys relaxing in a giant estate with swimming pools, greenhouses, a car park, a yacht and wine cellars. He makes the fatal mistake of telling his marginal relatives about the house. 

Stepan unsuccessfully tries to get rid of the visiting relatives, at the same time getting involved in love adventures. The boss unexpectedly stays in Turkey for another three weeks, during which Stepan will have to restore the damaged property of the owner, resolve the love triangle and save the company and the house from a raider takeover.

name: Про это самое
summary: After eight years of studying at the St. Petersburg Medical University, Mitya returns to his native village of Ozernoye, somewhere in the vast south of Russia. His family, friends, and the whole village are waiting for him with pride and impatience, because special funds were spent on his studies, and a young doctor at the local hospital is also very much needed. But everyone is surprised to find out that Mitya is not a surgeon, dentist, or even a urologist, but a sex psychologist. Conservative residents do not accept Mitya, they call him a "pussy doctor", his own father threatens to recant, but Mitya does not give up. Because he knows how much help is needed for people who are not enlightened in sexual matters, who for generations have tabooed the topic of "this very thing" and live in a world of myths, superstitions and prejudices.

name: Солдатская мать
summary: Moscow journalist comes to the Pervomaysky farmstead to interview Efrosinya Semenova, a heroic mother who lost nine sons in the war, on assignment from the editorial office. During long conversations, he discovers the courage and heroism of each son, as well as the indestructible strength of spirit of Efrosinya.

previousepisode.name: Бедные патриоты. Депутат Хинштейн: после принятия закона о зарубежных счетах многие депутаты покинут Госдуму

name: Meng Bao Zhu Gong: Wu Shi Sui Hun Chong
My Life Is Not My Husband's
TCL Team Boxing League
summary: TCL's 2025 season—its third—will launch with the Boston vs. New York battle (from Foxwoods Casino), featuring teams composed of rising male and female talent alongside seasoned veterans. Competitors in the first and only professional boxing league with a team-based ownership model will face off across 12 different weight classes in 24 action-packed, three-minute rounds, with team performance determining the overall winner.

name: Building Bad
summary: The series looks at what happens when scientists, inventors and engineers turn to the dark side – from the Italian Mafia's assassination drones and Columbian cartels' secret narco subs, to a network of New York City heroin processing labs and the ingenious escape routes in Pablo Escobar's Hacienda and Catêdral hideouts

name: В круге света
summary: The talk show "In the Circle of Light" is a joint project of the famous TV presenter Svetlana Sorokina and the editor-in-chief of the radio station "Echo of Moscow" Alexey Venediktov. This is a program for those who care about the fate of their loved ones, who are concerned about the future of their children, who are ready to fight for the happiness of their families. The program raises issues of social development in Russia, examines current problems of family, motherhood and childhood, and discusses the most important aspects of human relationships.

previousepisode.name: Выпуск 4. 	 Суд присяжных в России - за и против

name: Phoenix's Gambit: Love or Crown
summary: The scheming concubine-born daughter of the Minister's household, Bai Xiyue, caused the death of her legitimate sister Bai Xiyao, and seduced Duke Yun Yichen, eventually becoming empress. However, she was poisoned and died suddenly during the coronation ceremony. After being reborn with all her memories, this time as her sister Bai Xiyao, she finds herself face to face with the younger, ruthless version of her former self. Now, she must endure the very schemes she once used on others, strive to protect herself while atoning for her past sins, and navigate the tangled web of love and destiny.

name: Danska Konan
summary:
When Ditte Jensen retires with distinction from the Danish Secret Service, she movesinto an apartment block in Reykjavik where she will be able to tend her garden andlive out her life in anonymity. But Ditte can not stop being how she is. An elite soldier and a warrior. And soon the apartment building become here a battlefield for a better world. With her deep rooted sense of justice she sees her neighbor's problems and is compelled to help, whether they want her help or not.
And in her world, the end justifies the means. Always.

name: Верное средство
summary: A multidisciplinary clinic treating a wide range of traumas and human dramas. A variety of medical specialists work here, from anaesthetists and gynaecologists to plastic surgeons. Nurses are also available, where without them. Every day, these people not only save lives, treat illnesses and help people, they also have their own lives - their own problems, which, more often than not, lead to extremely difficult life situations. You may doubt it, but these doctors care about their own problems, and they care a lot!

name: Parlor Room
summary: Host Becca Scott gathers her comedian friends for a game night like no other.

name: Partner's Territory
summary:
An irresistible rough romance between three men who invade each other's realm.
Lee Je-jae and Shin Jin-gi have been separated and reunited. He now lives with Shin Jin-gi, a married man who is married by contract, but he remembers the selfish Shin Jin-ki who said he was not a homosexual and told him to stop.
Meanwhile, a new owner Lee Cheok appears in front of Lee Yi Je, who works as a manager at Soul Brush, and Shin Jin Ki complains about his charismatic appearance.

name: All Access PD: Grand Rapids
summary: From homicide to patrol, cameras follow the detectives and officers of the Grand Rapids Police Department.

name: SHIROHIYO - Reincarnated as a Neglected Noble: Raising My Baby Brother With Memories From My Past Life
summary: Ageha Kikunoi was a spoiled 5-year-old before he suddenly recalled memories from a past life. Then, he loved to cook, sew, and sing above all else. In this world, Ageha and his younger brother, Regulus, try to navigate the Kikunoi house as corruption among the aristocracy deepens. They'll need skills from Ageha's past life, blessings of gods and elves, and magic spells to help them on their way!

previousepisode.name: I'll Use My Memories from a Past Life to Make a Business Deal

name: Star Wars: Tales of the Underworld
summary: Enter the galaxy's dangerous underworld in this six-episode journey through the experiences of two iconic villains. Former assassin and bounty hunter Asajj Ventress is given a new chance at life and must go on the run with an unexpected new ally, while outlaw Cad Bane faces his past when he confronts an old friend, now a Marshal on the opposite side of the law.

name: The Husbands
summary: When Lauren returns home to her flat in London late one night, she is greeted at the door by her husband, Michael. There's only one problem — she's never seen this man before in her life. As Lauren tries to puzzle out how she could be married to someone she can't remember meeting, Michael goes to the attic to change a lightbulb and abruptly disappears. In his place, a new husband emerges. Realizing that her attic is creating an infinite supply of husbands, Lauren confronts the question: If swapping lives is as easy as changing a lightbulb, how do you know you've taken the right path? When do you stop trying to do better and start actually living?

previousepisode.name: I Think I'm Done Being a Witch

name: Qin Ai De Chu Shen Da Ren
Hunter Jame
summary: "Set in 1920s Shanghai, a city teeming with mystery, cultural fusion, and intrigue, Tianyuan Zhan and Liu Weiyi co-found a private detective agency. Both secretly in love with their childhood friend, Rong Shaojuan, their bond is shattered when Shaojuan tragically dies in a car accident while helping Tianyuan on a case. Blaming each other, the two part ways, and Weiyi joins the police force. Meanwhile, Xiang Jingrong, mysteriously tied to the accident, vanishes without a trace. Her daughter, Zhang Ziqing, returns from abroad to search for her missing mother. By twist of fate, she joins Tianyuan's detective agency, and together they begin investigating a series of seemingly unrelated and baffling cases, only to uncover a shadowy criminal organization led by the elusive and dangerous Mr. Bai. As Weiyi pursues the truth from within the police force, his path gradually converges with Tianyuan's. Despite past conflicts, they find themselves fighting a common enemy. In the end, with courage and cleverness, Tianyuan and his allies dismantle the criminal empire and expose Mr. Bai's sinister plot, ultimately paving the way for justice, closure, and new beginnings in both life and love."

name: Atonement
summary: At a class reunion, Qin Suyan is drawn into a deadly game where players face ruthless rules, real danger, and growing distrust—especially with the mastermind hiding among them. As others give in to fear and violence, Qin Suyan holds on to her compassion. While uncovering a connection to a long-buried case, she must decide whether revealing the truth is worth the cost.

name: Kostas
summary: Kostas Charitos is head of the Homicide Section of the Athens Police. Tenacious, he does not lose heart even when faced with the most difficult cases. Kostas is married to Adriana and has a daughter, Caterina, for whom he feels total love. In The commissioner's family background looms over the despotic figure of his policeman father at the time of the Colonels' dictatorship and passive spectator, if not accomplice, of the interrogations and violence inflicted on the regime's opponents.

name: АТП Перевізники
summary:
ATP: The Carriers is a story of true brotherhood on the road, where every kilometer tests endurance, trust, and courage. Artem and Semen are delivery drivers who navigate tough routes, handle emergencies, and fight to keep their struggling transport company alive.

Their job isn't just about moving cargo. It's about challenges that shape character, unexpected threats, twists of fate, and facing their own fears. This series blends adventure, drama, and humor — where the road is tough, but the bond of friendship is tougher.

name: The Diamond Heist
summary: Get in the Dome. Get the diamond. Get away. In this documentary executive produced by Guy Ritchie, a group of gangsters plan the heist of a lifetime.

name: Angi: Crimen y mentira
summary: Ana Páez was a 35-year-old fashion designer who was found dead in a tourist apartment in Barcelona on February 19, 2008, naked and with a plastic bag covering her head. How did she die? Was it a sexual crime or a sadistic game gone wrong? This was the initial hypothesis with which the police were working until Angi appeared. This documentary miniseries revisits what the media dubbed 'The Almost Perfect Crime' and sheds light on the figure of María Ángeles Molina ('Angi') and her past with her husband, Juan Antonio Álvarez Litben, who died unexpectedly in 1996.

name: The Weekend Primetime
summary: A diverse panel of journalists navigates the week's biggest stories and sets the agenda for the week ahead, offering context, analysis, and civil debate in a three-hour Saturday and Sunday evening format.

name: Destiny of the General's Bride
summary: Young girl Su Hua eloped with General Xiao Yun for love, but was betrayed by her elder sister and violated and buried alive by the second young master, Xiao Ye. Su Hua is "reborn" as the courtesan Qing Yan, enters into a marriage deal with Xiao Yun, and steps into the Xiao Residence to begin her revenge. Along the way, she fights through countless obstacles, rescues other persecuted women, ultimately brings punishment upon the Xiao family, and finally regains her true identity to reunite with Xiao Yun.

name: Destiny Switch
summary: Timecaster Luo Jie is accidentally transported into the body of a tycoon's illegitimate son, Lang, with the power to turn into a time pocket watch. In his quest to uncover the truth behind Lang's mysterious death, he becomes entangled in the Qian Gang's power struggles, crosses paths with Inspector Ye Sijia and the quirky Qi, and finds himself hunted by multiple factions. Luo Jie eventually uncovers that the mastermind behind it all is deeply linked to One Word of Humility and an impending catastrophe yet to come...

name: Castle Impossible
summary:
High school sweethearts and married couple, Daphne Reckert and Ian Figueira, will abandon their plans of living in a California tiny home when Daphne inherits her late grandfather's 500-year-old chateau on a 130-acre estate just outside of Paris, France.

While the main floor of the sprawling property—which once welcomed guests like King Louis XIII— provides a steady income stream hosting weddings, the young couple will take on the incredibly daunting task of restoring the remaining dilapidated floors and buildings on the grounds, utilizing their carpentry, conservation and landscaping expertise, as well as their families' backgrounds in construction, design and renovation. With passion, determination and grit, Daphne and Ian will confront budget constraints, battle bug infestations, hunt for rumored hidden treasure and tackle a seemingly endless list of projects head-on to breathe new life into the historic estate and preserve her grandfather's legacy.

previousepisode.name: A Fairytale Ending: The Enchanted Dove Tower

name: Dan Mu Jiao Wo Lai Gong Dou
How to Cook Well in Morocco
summary: In this new seven part series, Rory O'Connell visits Morocco.

name: Кохання та полумʼя
summary: The series is dedicated to the rescuers of Ukraine, who work every day on the front line of the fight for the lives of their people. Bravery, courage, and determination are shown not only in the characters' feelings but also in real rescue scenes, extreme situations, and deadly fires. However, the rescuers are ordinary people who also experience personal drama.

name: Qué Tranza
summary: Qué Tranza promises an unfiltered, laugh-out-loud experience that blends real-life dilemmas, wild anecdotes, and brutally honest advice. Each week, the hosts dive into personal stories submitted by listeners — tackling topics ranging from relationship drama and workplace chaos to existential questions — always with heart, humor, and just the right touch of irreverence. Whether listeners are dealing with heartbreak, family issues, or just need to disconnect from the daily grind, Qué Tranza offers a hilarious and heartfelt escape.

name: The Attaway Appeal Podcast
summary: The Attaway Appeal Podcast is a scripted podcast where Rhyme, Rooney, and the cast of your favorite Brat TV shows discuss gossip, current events, and the latest hijinx around Attaway and Millwood.

name: Sip or Spill
summary: Everything you ever wanted to know about your favorite Brat TV stars!

previousepisode.name: Gabby Morrison | When was your last kiss?

name: Before the End: Searching for Jim Morrison
Antikduellen
summary: In each episode, 2 people compete to make the best purchases, which they later sell at auction. whoever has earned the most money wins.

name: Relove My Space
summary: Unloved spaces are transformed into dream rooms by using clever design, upcycling and repurposing pre-loved items, in this home interiors series with a difference.

name: ÄIJÄ
summary: The comedy series ÄIJÄ begins when Tauno and his best friend Rasmus start seventh grade. Tauno realizes that he seems like a childish sissy compared to the others. He is in danger of becoming an unpopular outcast! Tauno starts a social media channel for dads and even changes his name, now Tauno is TJ. The goal is to get into the school's popular, tough gang of boys, who even hang out in the school attic - as long as Rasmus doesn't screw up the whole thing.

name: Maria e o Cangaço
summary: Maria de Déa, Lampião's companion and first woman in the Cangaço, is a fearless young woman who dares to have a voice in a group of outlaws. In a life of escapes and armed disputes, Maria faces a pregnancy and is subdued to the harshest law of the Cangaço: handing over her baby to be raised by someone else. She begins to live between life in the group and the hopeless desire to raise her daughter.

name: See It Saw It
summary:
In a land far, far away, (but not so far away) there lives a merry king who rules over a kingdom of much jollity and mirth...

...aided by his jovial jesters See and Saw...

name: Legado
summary: After a grave illness, a media mogul discovers his children's tactics threaten the empire he carefully built — and he'll do whatever it takes to save it.

name: Once Upon A Dream
summary: Shen Qingtang, whose family was destroyed when she was young, was taken in by Pei Congzhi, the eldest son of the Chengping Marquis' family, and became a foster daughter in the Pei household, living as his nominal sister. Over the years, she endured unfair treatment and oppression within the Pei family. The only person who could be called her protective brother, Pei Congzhi, is also a dangerous figure, leaving her uncertain of how to navigate him. With the constant pressure from the Pei household wearing her down, Shen Qingtang decides to break free, leaving Pei Congzhi behind, and escaping from a life full of peril and uncertainty...

name: Wild Sky
summary: Series looking at the volatile weather above four different continents, and how the creatures below find ingenious ways of surviving wind, rain, drought and blizzards.

name: Brat Pack
summary: Phoebe helps her fellow students at Attaway Middle School with problems of stress and romance while working up the courage to ask out her own crush.

previousepisode.name: Boyfriend Picks Video Games Over Girlfriend
#16 - Куруч, Ваш, Бурдашев, El Clássico, Solo, Korya_MC

name: Secret Ghost
summary: Sia, a university student chasing his dream of becoming a musician, lives a quiet life filled with uncertainty. Everything changes when he meets Blue, a former senior from his music club who died years ago. Blue's unexpected return from beyond the grave brings more than just fear. It awakens a connection Sia never saw coming. When a mysterious pact binds their souls, the line between the living and the dead begins to blur. Sia is pulled into a journey that will change everything, with no way back.

name: My View with Lara Trump
summary: My View with Lara Trump features big picture analysis and interviews with thought leaders, shedding light on the headlines driving the national conversation and affecting families around the country.

name: Touch Me Not
summary: A young man with a supernatural power of touch forms a team to crack complicated cases. What they do not know is that a mysterious killer is stalking them.

name: Mysteries of the Knights Templar
summary: Unravel the Mysteries of the Knights Templar - learn their ancient secrets and legacy alongside Timothy Hogan and Scott Wolter.

name: Kinahan: The True Story of Ireland's Mafia
summary:
Kinahan: The True Story of Ireland's Mafia tracks the Kinahan Cartel from its beginnings as a small-time street dealing operation in 1980s Dublin, to one the world's most feared and notorious criminal organisations. It is a story of gangland feuding, double dealing, betrayal, international law enforcement, and murder.

Providing new insight, information and exclusive interviews, this four-part series tells the in-depth story of the cartel known as the Kinahan Transnational Criminal Organisation (KTCO), with roots that start in Ireland but spread to the UK, mainland Europe and around the world.

name: Queen's House
summary: A revenge drama about a woman who believed she had a perfect life and then had her life completely stolen from her.

name: Ireland's Strongest Man
summary: The return of the iconic show at the Crumlin Road Gaol, Belfast brings epic strength tests which push the 16 strongmen to their limits as they aim to become Ireland's Strongest Man

name: Tracks East
summary: Focusing on questions of identity and conflict in the (mostly) post-socialist world, Tracks East approaches difficult issues from new vantage points to shed light on our complex present.

name: Ehtoolehto
summary: Meet Siiri and Irma, best friends and the queen bees of Sunset Grove, a retirement community for those still young at heart. With a combined age of nearly 180, Siiri and Irma are still just as inquisitive and witty as when they first met decades ago. But when their comfortable world is upturned by a suspicious death at Sunset Grove, Siiri and Irma are shocked into doing something about it. Determined to find out exactly what happened and why, they begin their own private investigations and form The Lavender Ladies Detective Agency. The trouble is, beneath Sunset Grove's calm facade, there is more going on than meets the eye, and Siiri and Irma soon discover far more than they bargained for.

name: Uncharted Waters with Peter Miller
summary: Peter Miller travels the world looking for the hottest fishing spots.

previousepisode.name: Peter targets Wahoo, Mahi and Blue Marlin off the Island of Anguilla

name: Tim Rex in Space
summary: Tim Rex in Space follows a Tyrannosaurus Rex (T-Rex) named Tim, his big brother Tommy, little sister Tia and triceratops bestie Kai as they tackle kid-shaped adventures with dino-sized solutions in space. Tim and his family live in a unique world comprised of a cluster of asteroids that make up the town of Rumbleton. This intergalactic environment is a quintessential 21st century suburban town, with each asteroid hosting family homes, cafés, shops, parks, and even a beach. All asteroids are connected by a network of slides, ziplines and trampolines, but can also easily be reached on a quick rocket ride.

name: The Cruise: Fun At Sea
summary: Following groups of Brits as they cruise the Mediterranean's most glamorous spots.

name: The Basement: A Vanishing In Apple Valley
summary: A two-part documentary about the abduction of single mother Tina Herrmann, her two children and a neighbour in the sleepy Ohio town of Apple Valley in 2010.

name: Tempting Her Fall
summary: A marriage alliance between two powerful families takes an unexpected turn when a mysterious figure shows up at the engagement party and shares a surprisingly intimate moment with the bride-to-be. Caught between family duty, tangled emotions, and a web of deceit, the bride is thrown into chaos. As the stranger's true motives slowly come to light, a gripping tale of revenge, love, and betrayal begins to unfold at the heart of a wealthy family's dark secrets.

name: Michael Portillo's Travel Diaries
summary: Edited versions of Michael Portillo's travelogue series featuring new footage.

name: Caras & Bocas
summary: Dafne and Gabriel's paths cross again, 15 years after being separated by a plot by her grandfather. However, their rapprochement puts the plans of the shrew Judith at risk.

name: Alma Gêmea
summary: In the 1920s, Rafael and Luna fall in love. Murdered on the orders of the envious Cristina, Luna reincarnates as Serena and falls in love with Rafael again, confirming their eternal love.

name: Jack the Ripper: Written in Blood
summary:
Rather than focusing solely on the identity of the killer, Jack the Ripper: Written in Blood delves into how the Whitechapel Murders fuelled the rise of tabloid journalism in Britain. The series shines a light on one newspaper in particular – The Star – and its shameless exploitation of the killings to boost circulation and profits, hindering the police investigation to further its own agenda. 

Through the eyes of present-day experts, this gripping series immerses viewers in the turbulent Victorian era, offering a unique perspective on how the press manipulated the story for its own gain, ultimately obstructing justice in the process. Through the eyes of present-day experts – including investigative journalists, former detectives, psychologists, historians, a former prostituted woman and author, and forensic experts – this gripping series immerses viewers in the turbulent Victorian era, offering a unique perspective on how the press manipulated the story for its own gain, ultimately obstructing justice in the process.

name: Amor Sem Igual
summary:
Their lives could not be more different. While his workday is ending, hers is just beginning. In this story, Angélica is a beautiful prostitute, known as ‘Poderosa', who regularly visits a roadside gas station. It is there that she meets the agronomist Miguel, a nobleman from São Paulo with a good character, who sells the vegetables he grows on his property. They barely cross paths, the attraction is evident, although they have no idea what the future holds for them.

Rejected by her father as a child, Angélica is a woman who soon became independent and is, without knowing it, involved in many mysteries. One of them has to do with a conspiracy to assassinate her. A task that is not easy at all, and which will be made more difficult by the unconditional passion that grows between the Angélica and Miguel.

name: Ultimate Processes
summary: In Ultimate Processes, presenter Francesca Chiorando visits ten very different places to discover what goes on in the world of modern manufacturing.

name: Until The Sun Meets The Star
Минаев Тревел
summary: Writer and historian Sergei Minaev travels through space and time to the sites of great histories—the Freemasons, the Knights Templar, Suleiman the Magnificent, the Borgias, the Medici dynasty, and the Holy Inquisition. Following these heroes, viewers will travel to Istanbul, Paris, Florence, Venice, Segovia, Toledo, Avignon, Valencia, Rome, and other cities around the world.

name: Talk Sex with Sue Johanson
summary: Sue Johanson was Canada's foremost sexual educator and counsellor, recipient of the distinguished Order of Canada.  From 2002 until 2008, Sue's wisdom and experience were available to American viewers on "Talk Sex with Sue Johanson", a live phone-in program that aired on Oxygen TV. "Talk Sex" also aired in 23 other countries, including Europe and Brazil. Weekly production ended in May 2008.

name: Kathputli
summary: Kathputli is a tale of how greed and deceit can lead to one's downfall, while honesty and patience pave the way to success. At the heart of this narrative are Tabeen and Areeba, two sisters whose vastly different natures set them on contrasting paths. Tabeen embodies sincerity, intelligence, and patience, while Areeba thrives on manipulation, ambition, and greed. Caught between them is Ayan, whose affection becomes a pivotal element in their lives. Unaware of the hidden truths and concealed feelings around him, Ayan's heart becomes a battleground for honesty and deceit. Will Tabeen find the strength to speak her heart, or will silence be her fate? Ultimately, will Areeba's cunning ambitions secure her desires, or will honesty and virtue triumph in the end?

name: Sunday Night Sex Show
summary:
The Sunday Night Sex Show was a live call-in Canadian television show hosted by Sue Johanson, which ran from 1996 to 2005. It aired on the W Network and was one of their most popular programs. Every week, callers would line up on the phone to talk to Johanson, about various topics from how to spice up one's sex life, to advice on how to select the right sex toy, to how to deal with various relationship issues.

For many years, reruns of the television show ran on the Oxygen Network in the United States, but American viewers were frustrated that they couldn't call in during the live airing in Canada. Eventually, a US version of the show, titled Talk Sex with Sue Johanson, was created.

name: BattleBots FaceOffs
summary: Get ready for an unforgettable showdown in Las Vegas this September – December! BattleBots Destruct-A-Thon is bringing you a series of World Championship VIII pre-qualifier events featuring the biggest names in robotic combat. Each weekend, four elite teams will face off in intense round-robin battles, showcasing their unrivaled fighting prowess. Witness the most feared robots in the sport go head-to-head with rising stars. All the action will be available on our YouTube channel, with early access exclusively for our Facebook Supporters.

previousepisode.name: This Bot Shocked Everyone. Another Might Be Done. | BATTLEBOTS FaceOffs 5

name: Tsunami - Paluu paratiisiin
summary: Tsunami - Return to Paradise is a 4-part documentary whose main characters have fought for his life in the tsunami and lost all their family members Liisa Suonsivu and Gerts Friman, a diver Jani Mäkinen, who survived the tsunami and worked in a rescue operation, and Detective Inspector Ismo Kopra, who worked in Thailand after a year after the disaster, responsible for identifying and sending every Finn deceased home. In the documentary, the main characters return to Thailand and places they can never forget.

name: Mysteries of Prehistoric Scotland
summary: In this documentary Tristan Hughes investigates Orkney's enigmatic Neolithic past. Crawling into 5,000 year old tombs and digging deep into one of the greatest archaeological excavations currently underway on the British Isles, he explores this extraordinary period of Scotland's prehistory.

name: Holy Fuck
summary: An extreme tantra school shows up at Ängsbacka, a course centre in Värmland, in 2010. The leader of the school propagated that one would explore one's boundaries and experiment with sex to reach divinity. We meet some of those who joined and came to end up high in the hierarchy in what would become Europe's largest tantra school. Now they are talking openly about what they have been up to.

name: Château Promenade
summary: After a few years of absence, Diederik Ebbinge returns to TV with Promenade. Not from the old, familiar studio, but from his picturesque Northern French chateau, where he will receive three special regular guests for six weeks. While enjoying a good glass and delicious French food, he wants to get to know them better through good and sometimes quite emotional conversations. The regular guests are also put to the test with some very tough trials.

name: Mijn jeugdrechter
summary: Phara de Aguirre returns to the juvenile court with young adults who were once under the supervision of the juvenile judge.

previousepisode.name: Jochem keert terug naar zijn jeugdrechter met vragen

name: IQ 160
summary: Greek adaptation of the 2021 French series HPI.

name: Shu Ling Ji
summary: In the boundary of Pazhou, there are hundreds of scholars, Tang poetry and Song poetry, all have Shuling 30,000 years ago, the gods named Nancheng Library descended from the sky, and the books in the Pazhou continent were born.

name: Fareed Zakaria Documentaries
summary: Fareed Zakaria Documentaries documents some of the most important and impactful stories at home and abroad.

name: Joulukalenteri: Kiltteyskriisi Korvatunturilla
summary: Who decides what kindness is? Santa Claus encounters a surprising problem at the forge: The gift warehouse is overflowing with packages that are in danger of not being delivered. It seems that this Christmas, almost no one will meet the requirements of the Great Book of Kindness, written by the overly cocky elf Hörö. Kindness Crisis at Korvatunturi is a family-friendly situation comedy that mixes suspense, crime mystery, and infatuation in the freezing cold.

name: Roni Back: Suomen Suurinta Piilosta
summary: Roni Back: Finland's Greatest Hide and Seek is a six-part series that brings the highly popular hide-and-seek games of favorite YouTuber Roni Back from YouTube to Ruutuu! In the series, Roni and his guests - both other well-known YouTubers and TV celebrities - compete against each other in a game of hide-and-seek in the most special places around Finland. Each episode offers unexpected twists and surprises that keep both the seeker and the hiders in suspense and take hide-and-seek to a whole new level!

name: Blind Channel: After Dark Side
summary: Blind Channel wants to be the world's most popular alternative rock band. To do that, they need to create an album that will propel them to global success. The revealing documentary series takes them into recording studios and behind the scenes of gigs across Europe and the United States. Behind the scenes, the band members also open up about their past struggles, from bullying at school to burnout, with unprecedented openness.

name: Rahdinmetsästäjät
summary: Rahdinmetsästäjät follows the everyday lives of Finnish truck drivers on the endless highways of the United States and Canada.

name: Suomi Pelaa
summary: Suomi Pelaa delves into game making, e-sports and Finnish gaming culture. Gaming is the world's biggest entertainment business, and we Finns do it really well - in our own way. Featuring Aleksib, Sami Järvi, also known as the face of Max Payne, streamer AndyPyro and the creators of the legendary Pro Pilki.

name: Moon River
summary: Joseon Crown Prince Lee Gang is known by many as an unserious, pleasure-seeking man, but he uses this facade to mask his deep pain from losing his beloved wife. While his mother tries to find him a new spouse, he's dismissive of her attempts, only wishing to pursue revenge. His life takes a turn when he runs into Park Dal I, a merchant with amnesia who bears a startling resemblance to his wife. Although Dal I and Lee Gang's first meeting goes poorly, they soon find themselves as unlikely allies helping those in need. However, the two awaken one morning to the shock of a lifetime: they've swapped bodies. As Lee Gang and Dal I try to figure out how this happened, they uncover political conspiracies and dangerous secrets – and that their connection might run deeper than they think.

name: Hotel Chocolat Unwrapped
summary: This new series steps inside the world of Hotel Chocolat, from its magical inventing rooms and the chocolate factory floor, to the cacao-filled tropical forests.

name: Juniori Suurmestari
summary: The junior version of the phenomenal Grandmaster puts children in the spotlight! The basic idea of the program is the same as for adults: children compete in tasks created by the Grandmaster that require intelligence, skill and wit. There will be speed and wild situations, as well as downright cutting analysis in the studio. The Grandmaster is rightfully Jaakko Saariluoma, and his right-hand man is judge Pilvi Hämäläinen.

name: Jarkko Tamminen Show – livenä lavalla
summary: Master of Ceremonies Jarkko Tamminen will bring over 30 of his iconic impersonations to the audience. Also on stage will be a live band consisting of Finland's most talented musicians and top dancers Marko Keränen, Saana Akiola, Anssi Heikkilä and Ansku Bergström, known from television entertainment programs. Jarkko Tamminen Show – live on stage is a unique spectacle with a big world show atmosphere

name: Big Fat Quiz: Best Bits
summary: This new series of special compilation episodes looks back on the biggest laughs from 20 years of Big Fat Quizzing on Channel 4.

name: America's Biggest Dog Show
summary: Clare Balding presents highlights from the 149th Westminster Kennel Club Dog Show in New York. This year, the historic event returns to its regular home in Madison Square Garden.

name: Sarjakusettaja
summary: The charming Jimi turns out to be the most destructive match of Roza's life. What starts as a seemingly perfect relationship on Tinder quickly unravels. Soon, it becomes clear that Jimi isn't interested in love—only money. Roza falls victim to an exceptionally ruthless identity fraud scheme, with Jimi accumulating massive debt in her name. The series is based on true events and includes dramatized scenes. Jimi is portrayed throughout the series by Mikko Kuokka.

name: Il metodo Fenoglio - L'estate fredda
summary: The epic story of how in the 1990s Bari crime transformed into a real mafia in the same years in which the Cosa Nostra attack on the heart of the state took place in Sicily with the massacres of Giovanni Falcone, Paolo Borsellino and of their respective stocks.

name: Jaakko Keso: Tämä on Amerikka
summary: Journalist Jaakko Keso has arrived in America! He plans to find out how messed up the United States and its people really are. Some citizens believe that the country is so deep in the swamp that the idea of a bloody civil war is not out of the question. On his research journey, Jaakko and his friend Brandon encounter incredible characters, embarrassing situations, dangerous places and endless laughter.

name: Barristers: Fighting For Justice
summary: Every year, over a million cases pass through the UK courts. And for the people in the dock, only one thing stands between freedom and a prison cell: defence barristers. From violent assault to international drugs smuggling and murder, this new series follows some of the country's leading defence barristers as they fight for clients accused of the most serious crimes. With unprecedented access, the series reveals what it takes to keep the scales of justice balanced.

name: Love My Face
summary: At a one-of-a-kind clinic in the heart of the Yorkshire countryside, activist Jono Lancaster and a team of world-class surgeons and doctors come together to help provide cutting-edge care, free of charge, to people who society treats differently because of the way they look. In each episode, three people with visible facial differences have the opportunity to explore and, if they choose to, receive transformative treatments from some of the UK's most sought-after experts. Whether they decide to have treatment or not, they're also given mental health advice and support from Jono, who works with them on responding to other people's perceptions and behaviour. In this unique, uplifting and life-changing series, people with visible facial differences are given choices and the support to make the decisions they feel will shape happy, confident and fulfilling lives.

name: The Further Adventures of Ellery Queen
summary: The second series was telecast on NBC from September 26, 1958 to June 5, 1959. It featured George Nader as Ellery Queen for the first twenty episodes and Lee Philips for the remaining thirteen. Les Tremayne took the role of Inspector Richard Queen.

previousepisode.name: The Murder Comes to You Live

name: The Man Who Murdered His Family
summary: The gripping story of the life and downfall of Grant Amato, whose obsession with an internet cam model led to betrayal, financial ruin and murder.

name: The Next Step Beyond
summary: Revival of the 1950s–1960s American anthology series One Step Beyond, purporting to tell true stories of the supernatural. It was again hosted and often directed by original host John Newland.

name: Blippi's Job Show
summary: From flying to the moon to making the perfect pizza, Blippi and Meekah are learning about the world's coolest jobs — and making new friends along the way!

name: Murha Hangossa
summary: Prodigal father Ruben Waara returns to his hometown and becomes embroiled in a murder investigation led by his police inspector daughter.

name: Asunnottomat
summary: The everyday lives of homeless people Jeren, Alisa, Tatsu and Midu are colored by insecurity and drugs. They spend their days walking or snoring. Sometimes they go to prison and when they get an apartment, it's hard to hold on to it. Love brings hope and dreams include a normal everyday life, a family and a job. First, however, they would have to get into substitution treatment, and that's not exactly simple. What are the prerequisites for getting into a good life when you have a violent childhood, an institutional youth and drug-fueled circles of friends behind you?

name: Alharich
summary: This is my first TV series and it's called alharich_S01. I ask the gang questions and we go to different places. In each episode there is a main question that I ask, but the question doesn't really matter in the end, because there is no real outcome in them. Maybe this is a documentary series or maybe this is an entertainment series. You decide, but this is always a kite. Love u chat <3

name: Ella ja Helmi IRL: Paras Kesä Ikinä
Aleksi: Ctrl+Alt+Dad
summary: It's been a year and a half since Aleksi "Mentalisavuke" Rantamaa put the cap on and began to recover from years of alcoholism. Now everything is fine: Aleksi has a wonderful relationship and a shared home with his wife. Suddenly, his whole life changes.

name: Time Team Podcast
summary:
Introducing the brand new Time Team Podcast presented by Martyn Williams and Dr Helen Geake. A new episode is released every fortnight on a Tuesday, sharing a unique window into the archaeology world, with news, insights and questions from our Patreon members.

TIME TEAM OFFICIAL -- March 29th, 2025 --  Exciting news, Time Team fans! 
The Time Team podcast is now WEEKLY!⁠ That's right—you'll now get fresh archaeology chats every single week. ⁠
⁠Make sure to subscribe so you never miss an episode, and don't forget that if you are a Patreon member, you have the exclusive chance to submit your questions to the Team and have them answered during the episode!⁠

previousepisode.name: It's been destroyed by fire. What can we still learn from it?

name: These Sacred Vows
summary: These Sacred Vows series opens the morning after the wedding, when the body of a priest is found floating face-down in the swimming pool of the young guests' villa. Over the course of six episodes, the action jumps back in time to revisit the key events of a wild previous week, each from the perspective of a different character.

name: Robson Green: World's Most Amazing Walks
summary:
The stunning new eight-part series will see the much-loved presenter and actor and keen rambler Robson Green embark on a series of unforgettable adventures along some of the world's most awe-inspiring trails.

Exploring treks across coasts, valleys, mountains and rivers, each episode will see Robson challenged to a single, iconic walk, sharing his passion for walking and unlocking compelling stories as he encounters locals, other walkers, historians, wildlife experts or geologists along the way.

From the sheer rocky valleys of Poland's Eagle's Nest Trail, over the ancient, well-trodden pilgrim route of the Santiago di Compostela in Spain, to the secret coves of England's Jurassic Coast – each journey will be filled with epic landscapes, fascinating history, and lush flora and fauna.

name: The People vs Michael Jackson
summary: The People vs Michael Jackson takes us inside one of the biggest celebrity trials of the century - the 2005 criminal trial of the music legend and icon, Michael Jackson. Drawing upon court transcripts, hours of never-before-seen home video, and more than 30 interviews with jurors, attorneys, celebrity witnesses, reporters, and observers, this documentary is not just a saga about family, celebrity and the media, but also a story about how wealth, privilege, and power affected the pursuit of justice.

name: Battle Camp
summary: In Battle Camp, the greatest stars from across Netflix's broad slate of reality and doc-series return to face the ultimate physical and mental competition, where a giant spinning wheel randomly decides who stays and who goes. In order to keep your name off that wheel, our returning fan favorites need to be unbeatable in high octane challenges, unbreakable in grueling punishments and, last but certainly not least, unhateable in camp, as everyone has a vote. The player who achieves all three, becomes the ultimate Netflix reality competitor and takes home the $250,000 prize.

name: The Dark Money Game
summary: The Dark Money Game films investigate the shadowy world of political donations and fundraising 15 years after the Supreme Court's decision in the Citizen's United case, which enabled unlimited spending by hidden sources on many political campaigns.

name: Cutthroat Kitchen: Knives Out
summary: Culinary skills will not be enough to rise to the top in Cutthroat Kitchen: Knives Out - where chefs must be willing to sabotage their opponents while being cunning in how they surmount the sabotages thrown their way. Host Brian Malarkey dishes out the unpredictable and diabolical culinary challenges that will test four chefs on their cooking prowess, strategic thinking, and ability to innovate under pressure. With a starting bank of $25,000 each, the chefs will have opportunities to spend that money on advantages for themselves or on sabotages for their competition. The last chef standing walks away with the money they have left in their bank.

name: Miss Xia Stop that Play Acting
Second Shot at Love
summary:
A story about a woman who was born and raised in a family of alcoholics escaping from her drunkenness. 

Han Geum Joo is a mechanic who becomes a public servant at a large company because she loves cars. She was called a "woman who drinks better than men," but when she is given another title of "alcoholic," Geum Joo decides to challenge herself by "abstaining from drinking." Seo Ui Joon is a doctor who was on a roll as a specialist at a prestigious university hospital in Seoul but ended up moving down to the rural village of Bocheon Health Center. He believes that alcohol is not a cure but an anesthetic and can ruin your life, and he will likely get involved with Geum Joo, who has been given the title of "alcoholic".

name: The List
summary:
Ready for a pit stop around the globe? Starting Thursday, 1 May on 10 and Paramount+ Australia, Jack and Falcon, comedic masterminds from The Inspired Unemployed, are diving headfirst into their wildest bucket list challenges in The List… and they have no idea what's coming next.

These two legends are on a mission to complete spectacular adventures in the most beautiful and exotic countries in the world. Unfortunately, their dream bucket list of things they want to do is replaced by a nightmare list of things they have to do. Some of the list items are physically demanding, some are emotionally draining, others are just plain awkward, but all of them are hilarious!

This six-part series will see the boys take on Germany, Japan, India, Finland, South Africa and Malaysia, they're pushing their limits like never before. From setting themselves on fire to getting slapped, and everything in between, these two will risk it all for your entertainment.

Laugh, cringe, and cheer as these Aussie larrikins take on the world in this brand-new series.

name: La caza del solitario
summary: The murder of two Civil Guard officers in Castejón, Navarre, in 2004, is the starting point for one of the most emblematic police investigations in Spanish crime history. The bullets recovered at the crime scene point to a robber who has been looting banks with impunity for ten years. He is a mysterious figure who hides behind a disguise; they call him "The Loner." His capture will become an obsession for the Civil Guard and the National Police. A police thriller with numerous plot twists in which the tension never lets up.

name: Supersense
summary: Documentary series which utilises ground-breaking effects and filming techniques to show how animals perceive the world around them.

name: You're Killing Me
summary: Set in a quaint New England town, bestselling novelist, Allie forms an unlikely alliance with an aspiring writer and podcaster Andi, to find the killer of a close friend. Meanwhile, Jack is the new lead detective of the local Police Department and former city slicker who is trying to acclimate to the quirks of small-town life.

name: Berlin Blues
summary:
Jonah, Talia, and their four-year old daughter, Renny, move to Berlin to start over - only to find out that they might be able to escape Israel, but they can't escape themselves. Based on the real-life experiences of series creator, Dana Idisis, "Berlin Blues" is a nuanced comedy about the challenges of moving to a new city and the complexities of Israeli Jews relocating to the country that just decades ago orchestrated their persecution. 

Jonah - a classical musician and oboe player - has always dreamed of playing with a prestigious world orchestra. But instead, he finds himself nearing forty, working as a private music teacher, and feeling that there's no place for him as an oboe player in Israel. 

Jonah's sense of professional failure and resulting financial hardships rouse fantasies of relocating to Berlin, a privilege made possible by the German citizenship he inherited from his grandparents. He convinces his wife, Talia, to join him. As a writer, Talia happily embraces Jonah's request to move to Berlin, thinking she will find inspiration for her second book. The relocation is thrilling, and materializes precisely at the right time. 

But Berlin turns out to be far from what the couple had prophesied; while Jonah flourishes as a member of a German orchestra, Talia struggles to write and feel at home. "Berlin Blues" tackles trials and tribulations of moving to a new city, a new home, and making new friends in a country vastly different from one's own - a never-ending set of hurdles.

name: Great American Stories
summary: Great American Stories is an anthology series where each season will be devoted to a different celebrated work, historical moment, or individual narrative celebrating and highlighting the American spirit.

name: Сказочный патруль. Хроники чудес
summary: The animated series is targeted at children three years old and up. Each episode tells about the Fantasy Patrol characters, who are already familiar to young viewers: Cat the Scientist, Magic Flower, Elizabeth Wise, Wood-Sprite, the sorceresses themselves, and many others. Plots and stories, made in the style of motion comics, reveal these characters and explain the motives of their actions. Viewers will learn about the past and previously-hidden secrets.

name: Adresse Basel
summary: The Eurovision Spring Contest is finally underway! A talented group, led by Marte Stokstad, is tackling this year's entry with great enthusiasm.

name: Next Gen NYC
summary: Next Gen NYC follows a tangled web of friends raised in the spotlight — or at least close enough for good lighting — as they stumble into adulthood one brunch, breakup and spontaneous decision at a time. Whether stepping out of their parents' shadows or creating their own legacies from scratch, these twentysomethings are determined to conquer Manhattan — if they can figure out how to adult first. Together, they'll navigate friendships, careers and romance, proving that trouble runs on espresso martinis and questionable decisions.

name: Bad Influence: The Dark Side of Kidfluencing
summary: In this eye-opening documentary exposé, teens and parents reveal disturbing accounts of abuse and exploitation within the world of child influencers.

name: Kayangan
summary: Kayangan is a realm of spirits and monsters. Habil, television host and lecturer has secrets. One, his father was a movie star. Two, the hero his father played was not fiction and Habil is heir to his father's mystic powers. Along with Ana, Bob and Zain, they assist Captain Jabbar and Vicky from the BASE task force to save citizens from Kayangan's threats.

name: Çırak
summary: Çırak, also known as Terekeme, is an assassin working for the mysterious organization 'The Company', which commits unsolved murders for its clients. Having experienced great injustices in the past, Çırak thinks that he is doing a good deed for humanity because the people who should be killed are bad people. However, one day, an event he witnesses changes his entire life and he finds himself in a struggle he never expected

name: Hell of a Night
summary:
Behind the slums and dark alleys of Kuala Lumpur, Sam cheats and poses as a shaman to survive. His victims are those who are easily fooled by black magic and by taking advantage of them, Sam makes money from them with cheap deception and illusions.

Sam also has a sixth sense and can see supernatural beings, but he rejects this belief because for him it is a curse. Dina, Sam's ex-lover, comes to ask for help in finding her missing sister after hearing supernatural voices, Sam tries to help Dina.

The loss of Alia is just the beginning of a bigger threat, involving a group of heretics from the elite led by a mysterious and charismatic man named Gusti. Together with Dina and Suria, Sam will be suspected of unexpected events while the city of Kuala Lumpur witnesses Gusti's grand plan in action.

name: Adults
summary: Adults is an ensemble comedy series about a group of twenty-somethings in New York trying to be good people, despite being neither "good" nor "people" yet. Samir, Billie, Paul Bake, Issa and Anton are five friends crashing together in Samir's childhood home, where they share their meals, anxieties and, occasionally, toothbrushes.

name: Riot!
summary: Riot! follows four students in a university where the misconducts of a professor often go unnoticed. Fed up with the injustice, they turn to music to ignite a rebellion that echoes beyond campus walls.

name: Canada Shore
summary: In this Paramount+ Canadian Original, a crew of party-loving housemates settle into a Kelowna lake house for an unforgettable, unfiltered summer filled with drama, hookups, and laugh-out-loud chaos.

name: Framed
summary: Lia discovers a mysterious polaroid camera that prints pictures of future tragedies. Can Lia prevent them from happening while investigating a bigger conspiracy surrounding her mother's disappearance?

name: Shlomi 6
summary: Two ambitious cousins from Netanya, who dream of playing for the most prestigious football clubs in Europe get involved with a criminal organization that trades players. In attempt to save their dream, the boys embark on a bloody coming-of-age journey that puts their future and their loved ones in great danger. A relentless pursuit of recognition and respect leads them to an inevitable collision.

name: Diafani Agapi
summary: A murder, lives shattered, pain, grief and a woman alone in danger. A vision, a door that closes without being crossed... Divided between reality and desire... Because all he took with him was love... We are on the roof of an abandoned building where two bodies lie there with their guns next to them. They seem to have shot each other. The blue police beacons are flashing and the officers are isolating the crime scene.

name: Влад решает
summary: The country's most famous "fixer," Vlad Chizhov, returns in a new role, inspired by the cinematic aesthetics of the detective genre. This isn't just a new look and a fresh approach to investigations—it's also new schemes, cutting-edge technology, and a team of like-minded individuals who have joined the project. Along with Vlad, the insightful "Techno" Yan, the fearless "Korean," the charming assistant, and the invisible "Coder" have raised the bar for investigations to new heights. Now viewers will see how the "sleuths" pursue clues and piece together the puzzle into a plausible fraudulent scheme. Together, they will engage in a fierce battle against the criminals, giving them no chance to escape.

name: Snow Patrol NZ
summary: Hit the slopes of Mt Hutt and Coronet Peak with the ski patrollers, medics and mountain rescue crews that race to keep mountainous thrill-seekers out of harms way.

name: Homeroom
summary: A homeroom teacher held 29 students hostage as vengeance for the mysterious death of their roommate. Their act takes a toll on life and sorrow. This bloodthirsty lesson brings up the raw characters of human beings.

name: Design Talks
summary: Magazine style intellectual aesthetic voyage, exploring art and philosophy in Japanese designs from antiques to high-techs, commodities and fashions. Hosted by Andrea Pompilio

name: Good Heavens! I'm a Goose Not a Swan
Москва слезам не верит. Всё только начинается
summary: Early 2000s. Ksyusha arrives to conquer Moscow with a five—year-old child in her arms - without money, connections, or any prospects. There is no turning back — she ran away from her hometown, fleeing from her abusive husband. Her new friends help her survive in the capital: a diligent medical student, Olya, and a flighty Masha, who dreams of marrying a foreigner and going abroad. After 20 years, fate gives her friends another chance at happiness.

name: Расклад на убийство
summary: Retired investigator Vera uses cards to contact her deceased mother, who helps her find clues in the most complicated and high-profile cases. The death of a loved one and the loss of a child have completely thrown Vera off track, so her husband, also an investigator, is categorically against her returning to the stressful work of the police, and he is skeptical about fortune telling. This causes conflicts in the family, because Vera longs to be useful and do what she loves, and the cards always suggest the right decisions.

name: The Great Lin Qian Jin
summary: After her soul transmigrates into an ancient book, socialite Lin Qianjin finds herself accused of poisoning - but no matter how hard she tries to clear her name, her nemesis, General Li Yan, remains hellbent on killing her. Left with no choice, she switches tactics: flirting shamelessly while investigating the case. Yet the truth remains elusive, and everyone seems to have a motive to murder her! As Lin unexpectedly falls for Li Yan, her hilarious, chaotic love story begins...

name: The Trisha Goddard Show
summary: Each weekday, Trisha helps everyday people and their families navigate through tough issues they are struggling to overcome. Her show covers topics important to viewers everywhere with her signature straight talk, warm heart approach. In each episode, Trisha uses honesty and common sense to teach people how to move forward and push through life's obstacles.

name: Trisha: Extra
summary: An exclusive insight into what goes on behind the scenes of Britain's best-loved talk show.

name: Long Way Home
summary: Best friends Ewan McGregor and Charley Boorman gear up for their fourth Long Way series—this time going from Ewan's home in Scotland to Charley's in England. They'll take the scenic route, of course, through 17 European countries on cranky old bikes.

name: Love in Turbulence
summary: In a blood-soaked encounter at a banquet, the Chu siblings are ruthlessly pulled into the whirlpool of fate. His right arm stained with blood, her tears falling onto old wounds, a fleeting kiss like a sudden bloom—brief yet unforgettable. However, the chains of ethics force them apart, and the flames of war ultimately separate them. A year later, Jiang Yichen uses an engagement as his weapon, closing in step by step, vowing to utterly destroy the Chu family. Yet, even the powerful are not immune to temptation! The young military commander willingly submits to her, kneeling beneath her cheongsam, ready to serve her. Meanwhile, a false brother betrays the ethical bonds that once held them, tearing apart all moral boundaries. The forbidden sparks of a love triangle between him and Jiang Yichen ignite, throwing their relationships into chaotic turmoil. She struggles in a web of conspiracy, her hairpin stained with blood and her white gown torn. Stumbling into his arms on a cold night, every step she takes is heavy with hardship, yet the abyss of fate has already opened. As hidden truths are revealed, bloodline lies, enemy communications, and foreign plots push all three toward the edge of life and death. Their destinies are already intertwined, and escape is impossible.

name: Tastefully Yours
summary: Tastefully Yours depicts the story of Han Bum Woo, the successor of a large food company, who runs the best fine dining restaurant in Seoul but has no interest in 'taste', and Mo Yun Joo, a chef crazy about 'taste' who runs a one-table restaurant without a sign in a remote corner of the countryside. They grow together and fall in love while running a small restaurant in the city of Miraek, Jeonju.

name: Broken Jade Chenghuan
summary: Jiang Yingwan loved Rong Shiqing, but was caught in a dilemma because of Pei Yanchen's persistent pursuit. After many conflicts and misunderstandings, she recognized her feelings for him under the protection of Pei Yanchen. But Rong Shiqing reappeared, making this relationship face more challenges.

name: Easter Vigil
summary: The Easter Vigil of the Lord's Resurrection live.

name: Oh In Colour
summary: A comedy sketch show written by Spike Milligan and John Antrobus, starring Spike Milligan and featuring John Bluthal.

name: Secrets Happened on the Litchi Island

summary: Toxic follows Chambers as she draws from her experience and background as an investigative journalist to delve into the dark and twisted side of relationships. name: Please Tell Me If You Have a Crush on Me
Mei Gui Cang Yu Sheng Xia
Gordon Ramsay's Secret Service
summary: Restaurateurs who are looking for a quick fix or social media glow-up are in for the surprise of their lives when famed culinary titan Gordon Ramsay trades his signature chef knives for a state-of-the-art surveillance vehicle and cutting-edge spyware in FOX's all-new unscripted series, Gordon Ramsay's Secret Service. In a Gordon Ramsay series first, Chef Ramsay will venture into struggling restaurants under the cover of night. With the help of a secret source on the inside, he'll gather raw, unfiltered evidence and get a 360-degree view of the major issues facing each restaurant. This insider will not only remain a secret to the staff, but will also help Ramsay infiltrate the restaurant after-hours for a dramatic nighttime black light kitchen investigation that reveals more filth and grossness than ever before. By the time Ramsay reveals his identity, it will be too late for staff to cover up their culinary crimes. Gordon Ramsay's Secret Service will be his toughest assignment yet as he takes drastic measures to transform not only the restaurant but also the staff, because Gordon knows he can upgrade the menu and renovate the restaurant, but the most important change has to come from the people. Are the restaurant and staff willing to accept Gordon's mission, or are they too far gone to be saved?

name: Drag Brunch Saved My Life
summary: Get ready to sashay and sauté with the new restaurant revamp lifestyle series, DRAG BRUNCH SAVED MY LIFE.
